newsitem.title: UK: BFCE sets $125 mln step-up perpetual FRN.
newsitem.headline: BFCE sets $125 mln step-up perpetual FRN.

text.p: The following subordinated floating-rate issue was announced by lead manager Morgan Stanley.

***TO GIVE A DISCOUNT MARGIN OF 3ML +89 BP
LISTING LONDON DENOMS (K) 10-100 SALE LIMITS US/UK/FR
